description: Používání internetu na mobilním telefonu is a dataset listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Český statistický úřad. The dataset contains indicators about how people use the Internet on their mobile phone. Coverage: Český statistický úřad. The portal shows the English title as "Use of the Internet on a mobile phone" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Český statistický úřad. Its keywords include ICT, chytrý telefon, informační technologie, internet, mobilní telefon. The listing shows 3 download or service links in JSON, CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/00025593/66a01ddae70ccd0809134744c60ce3f8/distribuce/7ca694c894256d3c050d06694ab9fc4a/podmínky-užití). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
